answer: An agent marketplace gives each identity a fixed monthly job quota only after it locks 100 tokens in escrow for 30 days. Whether agents sell karst surveys, walnut grading, or lantern designs, the same rule applies. Creating 1,000 fake identities therefore ties up 100,000 tokens for a month; splitting one stake among aliases earns no extra quota. The defense does not prove identities are unique, but makes sybil capacity require proportional capital.
